words.prose: {{ar:أَمْ}} ({{tr:am}}) opens the ayah as a connected challenge rather than a neutral alternative question. Its disconnected use makes the whole clause answerable by denial: the listener hears the claim 'is the wished thing for the human?' already being overturned. The particle also looks backward from the arrived guidance of 53:23 and forward to the ownership answer of 53:25, so the ayah is not a detached maxim about desire. Its short closed sound begins an audible m/n thread that later gathers around {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) and {{ar:تَمَنَّىٰ}} ({{tr:tamannā}}), binding denial and wish into one compressed question.

words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) makes possession the ayah's grammatical problem. It does not merely point toward the human; it opens a 'for/assigned to' slot and places that slot before the wished content, so the claimant is tested before the object is named. Because the preposition is fused in recitation with {{ar:لْإِنسَٰنِ}} ({{tr:l-insāni}}), the human is heard already inside the questioned possession frame. The same prepositional logic then returns in the divine answer of 53:25, where the possessor slot moves away from the human.

words.prose: {{ar:لْإِنسَٰنِ}} ({{tr:l-insāni}}) names the human as the questioned possessor, not as the actor who can secure the outcome. Its genitive case after {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) places the human inside the possession slot, while the definite singular makes that claimant generic: the ayah tests the human being as such, not one person's private wish. The root-family pressure around perception, familiarity, and the disputed forgetfulness association gives the generic claimant a sharper profile: a perceiving social being can still forget limits and treat projection as entitlement. The supplied co-occurrence evidence keeps the human-wish relation visible beyond this ayah (62:6; 2:94), and the liaison plus nasal sounds bind the noun between the denial opener and the wish verb. The same phrase returns in the effort formula of 53:39, where wish is replaced by striving, and the ownership slot is already redirected to God in 53:25.

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) delays the wished content until after the possessor has been questioned. As a headless relative, it points to 'whatever he wished' without naming the object, so the ayah denies a whole open class of desired things rather than a single item. The same surface can also press toward a verbal-noun reading, 'his wishing,' but the local grammar primarily treats {{ar:مَا تَمَنَّىٰ}} ({{tr:mā tamannā}}) as the delayed subject and object-domain of the verb. Its long ā cadence pairs with {{ar:تَمَنَّىٰ}} ({{tr:tamannā}}), and the same headless frame returns in 53:39 with striving replacing wishing.

words.prose: {{ar:تَمَنَّىٰ}} ({{tr:tamannā}}) lands the ayah on wishing. Its hidden third-person masculine subject routes back to the generic human, and its object-domain is the preceding {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}), so the clause asks about whatever the human has wished without naming one desired thing. As a perfect Form V verb, it presents the wish as an internally cultivated projection already formed in the self, not as the human's decree of fate. The wider {{ar:م ن ي}} ({{tr:m-n-y}}) field keeps allotment, fate, emission, recitation, and fabrication near the word, but local grammar narrows the sense to wishing/projection; the human is the wisher, not the one who apportions reality. Recitation and fabricated-projection pressure sharpen that wish against concrete parallels (22:52; 2:78), while still leaving wishing as the local sense. The same surah then lets this wish-word stand between {{ar:مَنَوٰةَ}} ({{tr:Manāt}}) at 53:20 and emission language at 53:46, and later answers {{ar:مَا تَمَنَّىٰ}} ({{tr:mā tamannā}}) with {{ar:مَا سَعَىٰ}} ({{tr:mā saʿā}}) in 53:39. The doubled n and long ā closure make the whole short question audibly land on the wish, and the boundary movement turns appetite and denied guidance (53:23) into a wish-claim answered by ownership in 53:25.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive construction لِلْإِنسَانِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ asks whether an inwardly pictured object becomes the human claimant's share.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus root inventory places wishing beside apportionment and measurement. The interrogative exposes a category jump: picturing an outcome is a human act, while measuring it out and making the allotment effective are different acts.

activation_trace.role: Visible human presence identifies the claimant whose imagined possession is tested.
An inwardly pictured wish supplies the subjective object but not its allotment.
Decreeing and apportioning supply the effective act that the question withholds from the wisher.
A weighing standard sharpens the gap between wanting an amount and having it measured out.

changed_reading.before: A person does not receive everything desired.
changed_reading.after: The verse interrogates the proprietary leap by which a human treats inward imagining as self-executing allotment: picturing, measuring, and possessing are not the same operation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَمَنَّىٰ names the act whose product is claimed by the lām of possession.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two form-distant branches let wishing behave as a self-recited script: ordered recitation can stabilize an image, while fabricated speech can make that image seem factual. The question interrupts the move from repeated representation to reality.

activation_trace.role: Ordered recitation lets the wish function as a script repeatedly placed into words or thought.
Fabricated speech supplies the risk that repetition simulates reality without making it true.
Perception entering awareness explains how an internal script can become experientially persuasive to its human author.

changed_reading.before: The human merely wants an unavailable object.
changed_reading.after: The human may be authoring and rehearsing a version of reality, and the question asks whether that rehearsal can confer factual possession.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The human named as possessor and the verb of wishing carry generative and terminal branches within the two focus roots.
baseline_models.mechanism: The claimant can be viewed as an apportioned creature between an apportioned material beginning and an apportioned death-term. His wishes occur inside a received span, so the one saying 'for me' is not self-originating or horizonless.

activation_trace.role: Visible human presence names the would-be possessor.
Seminal material from which form is apportioned makes the claimant himself a received product.
An apportioned death-term bounds the horizon across which the claimant projects desire.

changed_reading.before: A stable human subject fails to control desired objects.
changed_reading.after: The subject making the claim is himself generated and bounded by allotment; the question destabilizes ownership from the claimant outward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The local sequence names Manat, then calls the cult objects humanly assigned names, while the focus MNY inventory itself contains Manat as an idol-name alongside wishing. This permits a paronomastic reversal: a named dispenser of allotment is turned back into the human act of projecting an allotment.

activation_trace.role: The idol-name branch licenses Manat as a resonance of the focus root without asserting that the focus surface is a proper name.
The inward wish turns the nearby named power into a projected source of desired allotments.
An attention-calling interrogative begins the inspection of the cult objects and carries that examination toward the focus question.
Naming as public indication supplies the human act that gives a projected power its label.

structural_cues: 53:19-24 forms one interrogative sequence from inspecting named cult objects to asking what a human may claim.
The Manat token in 53:20 is used only as a text-level structural cue because the packet exposes no branch-citable root occurrence for that proper-name token.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the Manat surface, the focus-root branch that includes Manat as a name, and the nearby naming critique; I infer a deliberate local echo from name to wishing. A live alternative is accidental lexicographic resonance inside a purely topical sequence.

changed_reading.before: The question denies a generic individual's desired outcome.
changed_reading.after: The question may turn Manat's name back into wishing: can a humanly named power make the allotments projected onto it become the human's possession?

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, human naming is separated from compelling authority and paired with uncertain supposition and inward inclination. Activated by the fabrication branch of MNY, the wish becomes more than hope: it is a preferred description promoted into a claim of title.

activation_trace.role: The inwardly pictured object supplies the preferred outcome.
Invented discourse turns preference into an asserted reality and revises the baseline self-script into a counterfeit title.
A name marks and indicates, supplying the label that humans place on their projection.
Compelling proof supplies the missing authorization that a preferred label cannot generate.
Doubtful imagining supplies the unstable epistemic material from which the claim is built.
The self's inclination supplies the directional preference that selects the wished-for description.

structural_cues: 53:23 moves from assigned names to absent authority, then to supposition and what selves incline toward.
The initial أم and possessive lām in 53:24 convert that epistemic sequence into a cross-examination of entitlement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies naming, absent authority, supposition, inclination, and an MNY fabrication branch; I infer the arrow label -> repeated preference -> presumed title. Alternatively, 53:23 may diagnose false belief while 53:24 independently denies wish fulfillment.

changed_reading.before: A self-authored wish may feel real without becoming real.
changed_reading.after: The wish is a counterfeit title deed: human naming and preference can describe an outcome, but cannot authorize it or make it belong to the claimant.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next two ayat relocate both temporal domains to God and show that even an added celestial advocate is insufficient by itself. Realization passes through will, permission, and approval; the human wish is therefore neither title nor terminal cause.

activation_trace.role: The inward wish supplies the requested outcome entering the gate.
Effective apportionment names the operation reassigned away from the wisher.
The worshipped divine referent occupies the supplied possessive clause and relocates ultimate title away from the human.
The later domain extends divine title across the far end of the desired horizon.
Beginning and precedence extend that title across the initial domain as well.
Sufficiency is explicitly unavailable to intercession alone, blocking a direct wish-to-result path.
An advocate joining another supplies even the strongest imagined auxiliary, yet remains non-self-executing.
Will attached to a thing places effective selection on the divine side of the relation.
Permission supplies the explicit authorization gate between advocacy and effect.
Approval supplies a further criterion beyond the claimant's preference.

structural_cues: 53:25 directly answers the focus with فلله, replacing the human possessive claim with divine possession.
53:26 orders insufficiency, permission, will, and approval as a constrained realization sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine possession and a permission-conditioned intercession sequence; I generalize that sequence into a gate on the focus wish. The live alternative is narrower: the gate governs intercession only, while 53:24 makes a broader claim without specifying process.

changed_reading.before: Wanting does not itself allot the wanted object.
changed_reading.after: Even powerful mediation cannot realize a wished outcome autonomously; possession and realization are permission-gated within a sovereignty spanning first and last.

context_deltas.mechanism: Wishing projects a preferred future, but the MNY inventory also carries an apportioned death-term. First, later, lordship, and endpoint turn the question spatial-temporal: the human does not own the horizon into which desire is cast.

activation_trace.role: The inward wish projects a preferred state ahead of the present.
An apportioned death-term introduces a limit the projection cannot wish away.
What comes after supplies the remote side of the projected horizon.
Beginning and precedence supply the horizon's initial side.
Lordship and ownership identify who governs the path rather than merely its desired image.
A terminal limit gives every projected course an endpoint outside human ownership.

structural_cues: 53:25 places the first and later domains under one possessor.
53:42 closes the effort-recompense sequence by locating the endpoint with the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal poles, an endpoint, lordship, and a focus-root death-term; I infer that desire's future projection is itself bounded. Alternatively, these cues may address eschatological destination without coloring the phenomenology of wishing.

changed_reading.before: The desired future may simply fail to arrive.
changed_reading.after: The human does not own either the length or endpoint of the future into which a wish is projected; even the wishing interval is an allotted span.

context_deltas.mechanism: The possessive lām can be heard as a claim of entitlement. The later contrast says uncertain imagining cannot suffice against reality, while a branch of haqq denotes a right actually owned by its holder. Desire therefore lacks the evidentiary force to create title.

activation_trace.role: The inward image supplies the claimant's desired object.
A standard of measure raises the question of what valid measure, rather than preference, could establish the share.
Doubtful supposition supplies an epistemically weak basis for the claim.
Failure of sufficiency denies that the weak basis can discharge the burden of truth.
A right specifically held by its owner supplies the legal analogue that mere wishing cannot establish.

structural_cues: The lām in للإنسان makes possession or entitlement, not only fulfillment, the focus question.
53:28 repeats the non-sufficiency formula against الحق, keeping epistemic warrant and valid claim together.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies possession grammar, weak supposition, insufficiency, and an owned-right branch of haqq; I infer a title-and-proof analogy. The alternative is that haqq means reality generally, with no legal coloring.

changed_reading.after: The wish is also juridically ineffective: preference is neither evidence nor a deed of title, so the desired object is not owed merely because it is imagined.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first places the whole field under divine possession and matched recompense, then makes God the causer of wealth and durable holdings. These cues answer the hidden agency question in the focus: a wish does not convert itself into a share; having is derivative and administered.

activation_trace.role: The inward wish supplies the candidate object of possession.
Apportionment supplies the allocation operation whose agent the later sequence identifies.
Answering an action with a matched action anticipates the context's recompense economy rather than automatic wish fulfillment.
The divine referent anchors the supplied universal possession clause.
Matching an act with its recompense replaces wish as the operative relation between human conduct and outcome.
Caused wealth supplies actual sufficiency as a granted state rather than a self-produced projection.
Stored property supplies the durable possession that the focus lām leaves in question.
Settling someone through a gift makes receiving, not autonomous taking, the mechanism of contented possession.

structural_cues: 53:31 begins with universal divine possession and proceeds to recompense for what people did.
53:48 uses two divine causatives for enrichment and acquisition, directly answering who can turn allotment into having.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal possession, act-matched recompense, and divine causatives of wealth and holding; I infer that these resolve the focus's unstated allocator. Alternatively, 53:48 may concern material wealth only rather than every object of desire.

changed_reading.before: Human desire fails to produce possession.
changed_reading.after: Possession is derivative: outcomes are administered in relation to acts, and even wealth or durable holdings arrive through a causative giver rather than the wish's own force.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later clause nearly repeats the focus's human-possession frame but replaces what is wished with what is purposefully pursued. The pursuit is then made visible and answered with complete recompense, yielding a positive rule without making effort itself sovereign.

activation_trace.role: The inward wish supplies the relation that the later parallel clause displaces.
Action answered by action provides a latent bridge from wishing to the later recompense mechanism.
The same visible human claimant makes the syntactic substitution directly comparable.
Purposeful movement toward an objective replaces static inward projection with enacted direction.
Work and earning make the enacted direction an accountable human contribution.
Making the effort visible externalizes what wishing had kept as an inward image.
Recompense matching an act supplies the causal response to visible effort.
Completion without deficiency makes the administered response fully answer the effort.

structural_cues: 53:39 mirrors للإنسان ما from 53:24 but inserts ليس and إلا and substitutes سعى for تمنى.
53:40-41 orders effort, disclosure, and complete recompense rather than desire, possession, and automatic result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the close syntactic echo and the effort -> visibility -> recompense sequence; I infer that 53:39 answers the focus by replacing wish with accountable striving. A live alternative is that it defines the recompensable share, not all worldly acquisition.

changed_reading.before: The verse only negates the efficacy of wishing.
changed_reading.after: The negation opens onto a positive economy: the human share tracks enacted striving that is seen and fully answered, while the answering power remains beyond the effort itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later generative sequence repeats MNY in passive emission beside a drop and a further creation. This activates the focus's seminal branch and reverses agency: the human who projects wishes is himself a projected, apportioned creation.

activation_trace.role: The visible human claimant is the entity whose own emergence is reopened.
Seminal material from which form is apportioned provides a latent material underside to the focus wish.
A minute water-drop, including generative fluid, supplies the claimant's materially small beginning.
Passive emission realizes in context the same root's generative branch and reverses the focus subject's apparent autonomy.
Bringing a thing into existence extends the reversal from first generation to further creation.

structural_cues: 53:45-47 orders creation of the pair, a drop when emitted, and the further arising.
The exact MNY root recurs at 53:46 in a passive generative construction after appearing as active wishing in the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies same-root recurrence, generative fluid, passive emission, and renewed creation; I infer a designed agency reversal from projecting desire to being projected into existence. The alternative is ordinary root polysemy without cross-activation.

changed_reading.before: A pre-given human subject cannot guarantee the objects projected by desire.
changed_reading.after: The projecting subject is himself a generated projection from apportioned fluid and remains dependent on further creation; his wish cannot function as ultimate authorship.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it imports a later spatial fall into an affective inclination. It remains anchored through the focus wish and the packet's two H-W-Y occurrences, one for self-inclination and one for being cast down. Render it as a same-root trajectory activated around wishing, not as a lexical claim that wishing means falling.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The inward projection in تَمَنَّىٰ can acquire direction from the immediately preceding inclination of selves.

activation_trace.role: The inwardly pictured wish supplies a desired vector rather than an achieved possession.
The self's inclination gives the wish an affective tilt.
Descent into a fall turns unchecked tilt into a possible spatial consequence.

changed_reading.before: A wish is a static mental object that may not be obtained.
changed_reading.after: A wish can be heard as a directional tilt: inclination is already motion, and what feels like ascent toward possession may disclose itself as descent.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is form-distant because it activates the 'human image in the pupil' branch of insan. It remains focus-anchored and gains support from the surah's interrogation and later disclosure of what is seen. Downstream prose should present it as an optical analogy for self-projection, never as the translation of الإنسان.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الإنسان names the claimant while تمنى names an image formed inwardly.

activation_trace.role: The miniature human image in the pupil makes the claimant also a reflected image within an act of seeing.
The wish imagined inwardly supplies the corresponding mental image.
View, appearance, and mirror supply the optical field in which projected objects are inspected.
Making something visible contrasts an inward image with an externally disclosed act.

changed_reading.before: A human observer imagines an object and claims it.
changed_reading.after: The observer is also caught inside representation: neither the little human reflected in sight nor the object pictured by desire becomes owned merely by appearing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is an odd pastoral-material analogy drawn from the focus root's pregnancy-testing wait and the later generative sequence. It remains anchored by MNY at the focus and at 53:46 plus a gestational N-SH-ʾ branch at 53:47. Render it as latency and deferred disclosure, not as a proposed lexical sense of تمنى in 53:24.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The claimed product of تَمَنَّىٰ is treated as if projection already guaranteed its fruit.

activation_trace.role: A waiting period in which pregnancy is tested supplies latency between projection and knowable fruit.
Emitted generative material supplies the beginning whose outcome is not yet possessed.
Gestation and the arising of pregnancy supply the deferred process by which a beginning may disclose a result.

changed_reading.before: The wisher treats projection as immediate possession of its outcome.
changed_reading.after: Projection may initiate only a period of latency: its fruit remains unverified and cannot be claimed before a process outside the wish discloses it.

strongest_changes: The immediate naming-authority sequence revises wish into a preferred description promoted without warrant into a title claim.
The near-syntactic echo at 53:39 replaces inward wishing with visible striving, followed by matched and complete recompense.
The generative MNY recurrence reverses agency: the human projecting outcomes is himself projected into created existence.
The enrichment and acquisition causatives make actual possession derivative and administered rather than self-produced.
summary.what_was_special: One focus root holds wish, allotment, measure, recitation, fabrication, seminal generation, Manat, and gestational waiting. Context does not force these into one sense; it selectively activates several coexisting mechanisms that redistribute agency from imagined title to permission, effort, creation, and grant.
remaining_uncertainties: The Manat-to-wishing echo is packet-licensed and locally sharp, but its deliberate rhetorical status remains uncertain.
The permission sequence may govern intercession specifically rather than every wished outcome.
The owned-right branch of haqq supports a legal analogy, but haqq in 53:28 may remain broader reality or truth.
The effort clause may define recompensable share rather than all forms of worldly acquisition.
The optical and gestational outliers should remain analogical activations, not lexical glosses.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Wish is not possession.** ء ن س B001 supplies the human being; م ن ي B004 supplies a wish imagined in the self. The interrogative places *lahu* against *tamannā*, then 53:25 reassigns first and last to God. I infer that inward representation does not cause external entitlement; the ayah reads as breaking the arrow from desire to ownership.
2. **Human familiarity cannot domesticate reality.** ء ن س B003 supplies familiar comfort removing estrangement. In context, inherited names make the divine order socially familiar. I infer that a comforting, domesticated scheme can be wished into conceptual existence without becoming true; “the human” reads as the familiarity-seeking creature.
3. **The later semen use corrects fantasy with material process.** م ن ي B002 in 53:46 names semen from which formation is apportioned. That later occurrence activates a contrast between imagined wish (B004) and embodied apportionment (B002). I infer that outcomes come through created processes and decree, not free-standing fantasy; the ayah gains a material corrective.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 53:46 reuses م ن ي B002 for emitted semen, replacing imagined possession with a material, apportioned process of formation. That later root recurrence is the strongest surprise: wishing and generation share a root but not a causal mechanism.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Wishing attempts to become apportionment.** `م ن ي B004` supplies a wish imagined in the self, while dormant `م ن ي B001` supplies decreeing and apportioning a thing. The preceding desire-and-name mechanism and the following ownership and permission statements in 53:25-26 place the two branches in conflict. The packet supplies wish, actual ownership, authorization, and approval; I infer the arrow inward imagining -> attempted self-decree. The fixed question reads as a jurisdictional challenge: does imagining an allotment make it one's allotted reality?

2. **Visible human presence does not entail access to every domain.** `ء ن س B001` supplies visible human presence over against what is hidden, and 53:26 immediately introduces celestial agents whose action is still gated. The packet supplies the visible human claimant and an unseen authorization order; I infer the arrow visibility and desire -/-> possession. The fixed `للإنسان` gains a boundary-reading: human presence does not confer title to whatever it can wish.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - Later 53:25-29 distinguished wishing from allotment through ownership, permission, absent knowledge, and the choice of near life; the question became jurisdictional rather than merely affective.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi görmeyi temel alır, fakat belirli kullanımlarda işitmeyi, bir belirtiyi anlayıp ayırt etmeyi ve çevreye bakarak birini aramayı da aynı dalda aktarır. Bu yüzden dal genel ve sınırsız bir algı yetisi diye tanımlanamaz; her uzantı kendi bağlamına bağlı tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal duyusal olarak fark etmeyi ve belirtilen bağlamlardaki işitme, sezme ve bakıp araştırma kullanımlarını kapsar; yakınlık ve rahatlık duygusunu kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Görüp fark etme çekirdeği ile ses işitme, olgunluk belirtisini ayırt etme ve çevreye bakıp araştırma kalıpları ayrı tutulur; kalıplardaki kapsam çıplak biçime genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi görüp fark etmeyi anlatır. Belirli kullanımlarda bir sesi işitmeye, bir kimsedeki olgunluk belirtisini ya da kaygı veren bir durumu sezmeye ve çevreye bakarak birinin bulunup bulunmadığını araştırmaya uzanır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi gözle görerek fark etmeyi veya seçmeyi anlatır.
Belirli bir ses nesnesiyle kullanıldığında o sesi işitmeyi anlatır.
Bir kimsedeki olgunluk belirtisini bilip ayırt etmeyi veya kaygı veren bir durumu duyularla sezmeyi anlatabilir.
Çevreye bakıp dikkatle araştırarak birinin bulunup bulunmadığını anlamaya çalışma kullanımını taşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarılan anlam alanının merkezi görüp fark etmektir. Aynı ifade ailesi belirli nesne ve yapılarda işitme, bir belirtiyi anlayıp ayırt etme, kaygı veren şeyi sezme ve bakıp araştırma yönlerinde kullanılır; bunlar sınırsız bir genel algı anlamı oluşturmaz.

concept_gloss.text: görerek fark etme; bağlama göre işitme, sezme ve bakıp araştırma
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın görme çekirdeğiyle birlikte yalnız belirtilen bağlamlarda ortaya çıkan işitme, sezme ve çevreyi araştırma uzantılarını topluca verir.

error_profile.preserves: Görme çekirdeğini ve bağlama bağlı üç algısal uzantıyı ayrı olduklarını belirterek korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Nesne açıkça bir ses olduğunda kullanılan bağlama bağlı karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Sesin kulakla algılanması biçimindeki özel kullanımı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kimsedeki olgunluk veya kaygı uyandıran durum gibi bir belirtinin ayırt edildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Duyusal belirtiden bir durumun varlığını anlayıp ayırt etmeyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Çevreyi gözleyip birinin bulunup bulunmadığını anlamaya çalışma kullanımında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Dikkatle bakma ile birini bulmaya yönelik araştırmayı birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Yalnız görsel algı bağlamında yakın karşılık olabilirler. Odak dalın işitme ve belirtiyi sezme uzantıları komşuya, komşunun göz organı anlamı da odak dala taşınamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişi veya şey karşısında yabancılık ve ürkme duygusunun kalkmasını çekirdek anlam olarak verir. Yakınlık ve sevinç, rahatlık veren kişi ya da şey ve insana alışık saldırgan olmayan hayvan kullanımları bu çekirdekten bağımlı biçimde açıklanabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal duygusal yakınlık, rahatlık ve bunları sağlayan varlıkları kapsar; insan türünün adı, duyusal fark etme ve insana bakan yan anlamları dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yabancılık duymama çekirdeği ile rahatlık veren kişi veya şey ve insana alışık hayvan gibi özelleşmiş biçimler ayrı katmanlarda tutulur; özel biçimler bütün dalı tanımlamaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi ya da şey karşısında yabancılık, ürkme veya kaçınma duymayıp yakınlık, rahatlık ve sevinç hissetmeyi anlatır. Bu duyguyu veren kişi veya şeye ve insana alışık, saldırgan olmayan hayvana da aktarılır.

facets.statement: Bir kişi ya da şey karşısında yabancılık ve ürkme duygusunun kalkıp yakınlık, rahatlık veya sevinç oluşmasını anlatır.
Kişiye arkadaşlık ederek veya yanında bulunarak yabancılık duygusunu gideren kişi ya da şeyi adlandırır.
İnsana alışık ve saldırgan olmayan hayvanı, özellikle bu nitelikteki köpeği anlatabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, yabancılık ve kaçınmanın karşıtı olan yakınlık ve rahatlıktır. Bu durum birine alışıp onun yanında sevinmeyi, rahatlık veren kişi veya şeyi ve insana alışık saldırgan olmayan hayvanı kapsayacak biçimde genişler.

concept_gloss.text: yabancılık duymadan yakınlık ve rahatlık hissetme
concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişi veya şeyin ürkütücü ve yabancı gelmemesi, tersine yakınlık ve iç rahatlığı vermesi anlatıldığında dalın çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yabancılığın kalkmasıyla oluşan yakınlık ve rahatlık bağını korur.

error_profile.preserves: Alışma sonucunda yabancılığın kalkmasını ve yakınlık oluşmasını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.gloss: rahatlık veren yakınlık ile özel dostluk
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişiler arasında yakınlık ve içtenlik bulunan durumlarda buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Her rahatlık veren yakınlık özel ve arı bir dostluk değildir. Komşunun karşılıklı dostluk sınırı odak dalın nesne ve hayvan uzantılarına uygulanamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yabancılığın kalkmasıyla doğan duygusal yakınlığı ve rahatlığı anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.gloss: yakınlık durumu ile insan adı ayrımı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İnsan, iki dalda da temel katılımcı veya gönderim noktasıdır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أنس الإنسان بالشيء أو بفلان، المؤانسة والتأنيس، الأنيس وكل ما يؤنس به، الفرح بالقرب والحديث، والحيوان الأنوس غير العقور.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin güvenilir çekirdeği, bir şeyin insana veya onu kullanan kişiye dönük ve yakın olan yanıdır. Bu yanın solda mı sağda mı olduğu konusunda aktarımlar uyuşmaz; hayvan ve yay örnekleri yönü işlevsel ilişkiyle belirler. Bu nedenle sabit bir sağ-sol tanımı dalın özüne konamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, bir nesnenin insana veya kullanıcıya bakan yanını belirtir; salt sol, salt sağ, genel ön taraf ya da insanın kendisi anlamına gelmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak dalın insana dönük yan çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır. Hayvan ve yay uygulamaları bu çekirdeğin örneklenmesidir; yalnız bu kullanımlardan yeni bir genel yön anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir nesnenin insana, kullanıcıya veya onun bulunduğu yöne bakan yanıdır. Hayvan ve yay üzerinde işlevsel ilişkiyle belirlenir; bu yanın sabit olarak sol ya da sağ sayılması konusunda aktarım uyuşmazlığı vardır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin insana en yakın olan veya insana doğru bakan yanını belirtir.
Hayvanda binicinin bulunduğu, binme ve sağma işlemlerinde insana yakın olan yanı anlatır.
Yayda okçuya doğru bakan ve kullanıcının karşısında bulunan yanı anlatır.
İnsana yakın yan bazı aktarımda sol, başka bir aktarımda sağ diye belirlenir; yönün özü bu değişken tanımlardan bağımsızdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlam, nesnenin insana veya kullanıcıya dönük yanıdır; hayvanda biniciye, yayda okçuya göre belirlenir. İnsan bedenindeki tekil uygulamada öteki bacağa bakan yan kastedilir. Bu yanın solda mı sağda mı bulunduğuna ilişkin anlatımlar ayrıştığı için genel tanım sabit bir yön seçmez.

error_profile.preserves: Yanı sabit sağ veya sola bağlamadan insana göre yönelmiş olmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hayvanın binme ve sağma sırasında insana yakın kalan yanı anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanın yanını biniciyle kurduğu işlevsel ilişkiye göre belirler.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yayın kullanım sırasında okçuya doğru dönük olan yüzü belirtilirken uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yay yüzünün yönünü okçunun konumuna göre belirleme özelliğini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal genel olarak ön, önde, yakın veya karşıda bulunma yönlerini kişiye bağlı bir kullanım ilişkisi gerektirmeden anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda yön, insanın nesneyle kurduğu konum veya kullanım ilişkisine bağlıdır. Komşu dalın genel ön ve yakın anlamları bu özel bağı gerektirmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, yönelme tamamlandıktan sonra insana dönük olan sabit yanı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yüz, baş, el, kap veya hayvanın bir hedefe doğru dönmesi ve yönelmesi eylemini anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bir nesnenin insana dönük yanı bir bölüm adıdır; komşu ise dönme veya yönelme olayını anlatır. Sonuç konumu ile o konuma geçiş eylemi birbirinin yerine kullanılamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal insana veya kullanıcıya yakın ve ona bakan yanı gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir şeyin arkasında kalan, yüzünün karşıtı olan arka bölümünü gösterir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bağlama göre karşıt görünebilseler de odak dal her zaman geometrik ön yüz değildir ve bu yüzden düzenli bir karşıt çift oluşturmaz; belirleyici ölçüt insana yakınlıktır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه إنسي الدابة والقوس وكل شيئين: ما يلي الإنسان أو يقبل على الراكب أو الرامي، في مقابلة الوحشي.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل الإنسان نفسه ولا الأنس النفسي ولا الإبصار.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الإنسي الأيسر من كل شيء وقيل الأيمن وما أقبل منهما على الإنسان فهو إنسي وإنسي القوس ما أقبل عليك منها (sihah)؛ الإنسي من الدواب الجانب الأيسر الذي منه يركب ويحتلب ومن الإنسان الجانب الذي يلي الرجل الأخرى (tahdhib)؛ إنسي الدابة للجانب الذي يلي الراكب وإنسي القوس للجانب الذي يقبل على الرامي (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ortak çekirdeği, gözün kara bölümünde görülen küçük insan biçimli görüntü veya yansımadır. Parmak ucu anlamı tek aktarım içinde eklenir ve gözdeki görüntünün kurucu parçası değildir; bağımlı bir kaynak varyantı olarak tutulmalıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin çekirdeği, kişinin eylemini başkasının eylemiyle ölçerek ona yetişmeye veya onunla yarışmaya çalışmasıdır. Aynı toplu iddia uzatma, bekleme, karşılık verme ve sırayla binme anlamlarını da aktarır; bunlar yarışma çekirdeğiyle eşitlenmeden ayrı kullanımlar olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal dilek, üreme sıvısı veya ölçü birimi değildir; bekleme ve karşılık verme kullanımları yarışmanın zorunlu aşamaları sayılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yarışma bildiren türemiş birimi ve uzatma, bekleme, karşılık verme gibi biçim anlamlarını ayrı yüzlerde tutar; bu farklı kullanımlar tek bir yalın anlama kaynaştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Çekirdekte, kendi eylemini başkasınınkiyle ölçerek ona yetişmeye, onunla yarışmaya veya yaptığına denk karşılık vermeye çalışmaktır. Aynı biçim ailesinde işi uzatma, bekleme ve sırayla binme gibi ayrı kullanımlar da bulunur.

facets.statement: Kişi kendi eylemini başkasının eylemiyle karşılaştırır ve ona denk olmaya ya da onunla yarışmaya çalışır.
Aynı biçim işi uzatma veya bir şeyi bekleme anlamında da kullanılır.
Denk karşılık verme ve bineğe sırayla binme anlamları da bu biçim ailesinde aktarılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak anlatımı, eylemleri ölçerek yarışma çekirdeğinin yanında işi uzatma, bekleme, denk karşılık verme ve sırayla binme kullanımlarını da aktarır; bu kullanımlar tek bir kurucu süreç değildir.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılıklı yarışma ve denk olmaya çalışma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Eylemleri ölçme açıklamasını ve bekleme, uzatma, karşılık verme kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kaynakta ayrı biçim anlamı olarak verilen bekleme ve sürüncemede bırakma bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bekleme ve işi uzatma biçim anlamlarını bağlama uygun olarak korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, çiftleşme sonrasında devenin gebe kalıp kalmadığının anlaşıldığı günleri ve bu amaçla yapılan el muayenesini açıkça verir. Sunulan çerçeve süre ile denetim eylemini doğru ilişkilendirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım devenin gebeliğinin araştırıldığı günleri bildiren kuruluşu ve bu araştırmayı yapan eylem biçimini ayırır; dönem ile muayene tek bir nesne gibi sunulmaz.

concept_map.definition: Çiftleşmeden sonra bir devenin gebe kalıp kalmadığının araştırıldığı günler ve bu dönemde sağrı bölgesine elle vurularak yapılan denetimdir.

facets.statement: Çiftleşmeden sonraki belirli günlerde devenin gebe olup olmadığı araştırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, devenin çiftleşme sonrasında gebe kalıp kalmadığının araştırıldığı süreyi ortak anlam olarak verir; bir anlatım bu araştırmanın elle yapılan denetim biçimini de açıklar.

error_profile.preserves: Denetim dönemini, gebelik belirsizliğini ve elle yapılan muayeneyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz konusu biçim, günleri değil devenin gebeliğini araştırma eylemini anlatıyorsa kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Devenin gebelik durumunu araştırma eylemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Araştırmanın yapıldığı günler ile sağrıya elle vurma yöntemini açıkça belirtmez.
